proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b c hab
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := a) (by simp)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hv b (by simp)
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hv c (by simp)
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hr hr'
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hab (by simpa using hr.symm)
    refine ⟨r' / r, ?_⟩
    have e1 : b - a = r • v := by rw [hr]; abel
    have e2 : c - a = r' • v := by rw [hr']; abel
    rw [e1, e2, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hr0]
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨b - a, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨t, by rw [← ht]; simp⟩
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b c : V), a ≠ b → (Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, c - a = t • (b - a))
